fichas.title: Natural Stone Masonry
fichas.summary: Natural stone walling is categorized as rubble, cyclopean, coursed, ashlar, or composite masonry. The page describes stone cleavage, block proportions, bonding and jointing requirements, mortar, composite construction, cladding, and reference strength values for stone masonry.

dimensions.label: Block length to block height
dimensions.context: Block length should not exceed four to five times the block height; it should not be less than the height.
dimensions.ocr_raw: The block length should not be more than four to five times the block height and should not be less than the height

dimensions.label: Minimum block length to block height
dimensions.context: Block length should not be less than the block height.
dimensions.ocr_raw: should not be less than the height

dimensions.label: Course leveling interval
dimensions.context: A course should be brought flat and level at intervals no greater than 1.5 m.
dimensions.ocr_raw: a course should be brought flat and level every ≤1.5 m

dimensions.label: Minimum header depth to course height
dimensions.context: Header depth into the wall must be at least 1½ times the course height.
dimensions.ocr_raw: The depth (into the wall) of the headers must be at least 1½ times the course height

dimensions.label: Minimum header depth
dimensions.context: Header depth into the wall must be at least 30 cm.

dimensions.label: Stretcher depth to course height
dimensions.context: Stretcher depth into the wall should be about equal to the course height.
dimensions.ocr_raw: The depth (into the wall) of the stretchers must be about equal to the course height.

dimensions.label: Minimum vertical-joint cover in coursed masonry
dimensions.context: Vertical joints must be covered by at least 10 cm in coursed masonry.
dimensions.ocr_raw: The vertical joints must be covered by ≥10 cm in coursed masonry

dimensions.label: Minimum vertical-joint cover in ashlar masonry
dimensions.context: Vertical joints must be covered by at least 15 cm in ashlar masonry.

dimensions.label: Joint thickness
dimensions.context: Approximate joint thickness, depending on roughness and working method.
dimensions.ocr_raw: The joints should be about 3 cm thick

dimensions.label: Stone cladding thickness
dimensions.context: Thickness of non-load-bearing stone cladding fixed to a backing wall with anchors.
dimensions.ocr_raw: Non-load-bearing stone cladding of 2.5–5 cm thickness is fixed to the backing wall with anchors
